newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO, ICA DISSOLVE CROSS SHAREHOLDING.
newsitem.headline: KESKO, ICA DISSOLVE CROSS SHAREHOLDING.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said in a statement on Friday it and Swedish ICA Handlarnas AB had sold all their mutual shareholdings linked to a cross-ownership established in 1993.
"Kesko and Swedish ICA Handlarnas AB inform that they have sold all the mutual shareholdings related to the cross ownership established in 1993," Kesko said.
Unlisted ICA had reduced its holding in Kesko gradually this year from 3.24 percent of shares and 0.07 percent of votes at the end of 1995, a Kesko spokesman said.
Kesko earlier held less than 10 percent of ICA's share capital, executive vice president Matti Honkala said.
The companies have also agreed that Kesko will acquire ICA's stake in the coffee roastery Viking Coffee Ltd, which was previously jointly owned by these companies.

"According to the companies, the cooperation between Kesko and ICA can continue and also further develop without cross ownership. When the funds tied up in the ownership are released, they can be used for the operational activities of these companies in the Swedish and Finnish markets," Kesko said.
